items.description: Tenant must defend, at its own cost, any indemnified Claim brought against Landlord or the Landlord Group once Landlord gives notice.
items.span_text: Tenant, upon notice from Landlord, shall defend such action or proceeding at Tenant’s cost and expense.

items.description: Landlord must defend and indemnify Tenant and Tenant Parties against third party claims for injury or property damage caused by Landlord Group's active gross negligence or willful misconduct, subject to the lease limits.
items.span_text: Landlord hereby agrees to defend, indemnify and hold harmless Tenant and the Tenant Parties from and against (and to reimburse Tenant and any Tenant Parties for) all third party Claims to the extent arising from, in connection with, or in any manner relating to (or alleged to arise from, to be in connection with, or to be in any manner related to) injuries to persons or damage to property to the extent caused by the active gross negligence or willful misconduct of Landlord or any member of the Landlord Group at the Property

items.description: Landlord must defend, at its own cost, any indemnified Claim brought against Tenant or the Tenant Group once Tenant gives notice.
items.span_text: Landlord, upon notice from Tenant, shall defend such action or proceeding at Landlord’s cost and expense.

items.description: Tenant must have each of its contractors acknowledge in writing that they work solely for Tenant and that Tenant is not Landlord's agent.
items.span_text: Tenant shall require each contractor which it engages to perform any improvements or alterations within the Tenant Space or elsewhere in the Building or the Property, to acknowledge and agree in writing that it is performing its work under its agreement with Tenant solely for the benefit of Tenant and that Tenant is not acting as Landlord’s agent.

items.anchor_event: later of filing of the lien or Tenant being made aware of the lien
items.description: Tenant must discharge any mechanic's lien, by bonding or otherwise, within thirty calendar days after the later of the lien filing or Tenant learning of it.
items.span_text: Any mechanic’s lien filed against the Tenant Space, the Building or the Property, or any portion of any of the above, for work claimed to have been done, or materials claimed to have been furnished to Tenant, shall be duly discharged by Tenant, by bonding or otherwise, within thirty (30) calendar days after the later of: (i) filing of the lien, or (ii) Tenant being made aware of the lien.

items.description: Upon a Tenant Event of Default, Landlord may pursue damages, specific performance, injunctive relief, or the remedies in Exhibit D.
items.span_text: Landlord shall, in addition to an action for money damages, specific performance and/or injunctive relief, have the option to pursue any one or more of the remedies described in Section 1 of Exhibit “D” attached hereto
items.trigger: Upon the occurrence of any Event of Default by Tenant
